title: Figure 15: Negative Refraction With "Bulk" Optical Metamaterials Made of Nano-Fishnets
description: Three-panel figure. Panel a is a scanning electron microscope image of a nano-fishnet metamaterial prism with a 5 μm scale bar and a close-up inset. Panel b diagrams light refracting through the prism on quartz, with labels n = 1 and n < 0 and angles α and β. Panel c shows the optical setup with "Laser beam," "Lens 1," "Sample," "Lens 2" and "Camera," and an image inset marked n = 1.5 and n = -1.
